segments.text: Ok so this is the A2UI page for AG2 with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.

This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.

So basically, the page says a catalog is required, and then uses one it never defines.

That's the problem here, please have a look.
